title: Watch TFL Studio kill the copy-paste era
summary: Watch how TFL Studio helps PK and PD scientists build tables, figures, and listings up to 50% faster in Certara's cloud native Phoenix platform. The post Watch TFL Studio kill the copy-paste era appeared first on Certara .
body_markdown:
Get a quick look at TFL Studio, Certara’s no-code way to turn source data into polished tables, figures, and listings. This short video highlights the reusable templates, point-and-click editing, and built-in audit trails that make it possible. Contact us for a full demo.


### View transcript


Phoenix Cloud TFL Studio helps PK scientists save time, reduce errors, and stay compliant by automating TFL creation for NCA studies. Built for PK workflows, with scatter, box, and bar plot support and user friendly styling. Reusable templates and dataset mappings automate repetitive tasks for faster output with fewer QC cycles.


Flexible table support covers column and row stratification, data summarization, and row identifiers.


Set up standard automations for common actions like label and value replacements and statistics rules.


And built in review and commenting let you collaborate seamlessly with colleagues and QA.


## Learn more about TFL Studio


The “Easy Button” for Your Everyday PK/PD Analysis
